message.content:
**Typical Lasagna Ingredients** | Category | Common Items | |----------|--------------| | **Pasta** | • Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | | **Meat** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | | **Sauce** | • Tomato sauce or passata
• Tomato paste (optional for thicker sauce) | | **Cheese** | • Ricotta or cottage cheese
• Shredded mozzarella
• Grated Parmesan | | **Eggs** | • 1–2 eggs (to bind ricotta mixture) | | **Vegetables** | • Onion (finely chopped)
• Garlic (minced)
• Optional: spinach, mushrooms, zucchini | | **Seasonings** | • Olive oil
• Salt & pepper
• Dried oregano
• Dried basil
• Red pepper flakes (optional) | | **Extras** | • Fresh parsley or basil for garnish
• A splash of red wine (optional in sauce) | *Tip:* For a richer flavor, sauté onions and garlic in olive oil before adding the meat, then stir in the tomato sauce and seasonings. Mix ricotta with an egg, salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg before layering.*
